trap.label: rule out
trap.wrong: We ruled out of the idea completely.
trap.right: We ruled the idea out completely.
trap.why: Em português “descartar de” soa natural. Em inglês, rule out é transitivo: sem of; com pronome, rule it out.

fix.wrong: We ruled out of the plan.
She narrowed down it to two.
fix.right: She narrowed it down to two.

rewrite.prompt: Use rule out: “They discarded the plan.”
Com pronome: “They ruled out the plan.” (it)
Use rule out completely: “We discarded the idea entirely.”
rewrite.answer: We ruled out the idea completely.
